sources.note: 7daysperformance.co.uk is a pure JS SPA (no public SSR list); using Showroom's operator page (top picks only).
botb.com is JS-rendered (no public SSR list); using Showroom's BOTB operator page (top picks only, no closing dates).

sources.source: Birmingham & West Midlands local (Birmingham Live, Coventry Live)
sources.note: Reach's Birmingham Mail / Birmingham Live and Coventry Telegraph / Coventry Live giveaways; only articles from the last 45 days (or with a future closing date). Express & Star and Birmingham World have no competitions page; Hits Radio Birmingham and Greatest Hits Radio West Midlands come from the Bauer regional source.
Newsquest's Brighton daily; its public competitions page (Newsquest group prizes, subscriber-only ones marked).
Anthem Publishing Ltd (Co. no. 04542063) music magazine; gig / weekender-festival tickets as well as vinyl & box sets. Full T&Cs on Anthem's site.

Kelsey Media Ltd (Co. no. 05822990, inc. 2006, Yalding, Kent): Coast magazine's own competitions page (UK hotel, spa and cottage breaks). Kelsey terms on each page: entry is free, UK 18+, one per household; no login (kelseydirect.com form); robots.txt allows all.
Small paid car operator; own public listing (WooCommerce).
Server-rendered 'free entry' + 'best odds' pages (top ~26 per category); 'View draw' links point to Showroom (robots: not crawled).
Curated free comps (closing-soonest first, ~10 pages); promoter link is behind /redir (disallowed) so link goes to the listing page.
Free comps; links point at the site's own detail page.
Hand-checked one-off competitions on the promoter's own page that no scraper covers (comptracker/data/curated.json). Each has a closing date and drops off automatically once it passes.
Operator's own public listing (robots allow all).
Comparison site covering 100+ paid/free operators; direct operator links + ticket counts from public detail pages (cached, capped per run).
Small golf-focused paid prize-draw operator (golf holidays, clubs, trolleys); own public listing, robots allow. Paid tickets from about £1 with a free postal route on every draw.

sources.source: Hampshire newspapers (Daily Echo, Hampshire Chronicle, Basingstoke Gazette, Andover & Romsey Advertiser)
sources.note: Newsquest's Hampshire titles share one competitions system (often the same network-wide prizes; merged as duplicates). Many are digital-subscriber only. The News Portsmouth has no public competitions page.
Visit Hampshire (official tourism site) competitions and Hampshire Life magazine giveaways ('Win …' articles).
ITV's competitions hub (This Morning, GMB, Loose Women...). One request per run to the JSON the page itself loads.
The Island's newspaper (Newsquest). Its competitions page; many are open to digital subscribers only (flagged as paid entry).

sources.source: Isle of Wight local news & tourism (OnTheWight, Island Echo, Visit Isle of Wight)
sources.note: OnTheWight (WordPress public API search), Island Echo (public RSS feed) and Visit Isle of Wight's competitions page; only posts that are giveaways ('Win …'). Often none are running.
Community-posted UK competitions (mostly free). Data embedded in the public listing pages (first pages only); links go to Latest Deals' page for each comp.

London giveaways from MyLondon (Reach) and Secret London; only articles with a future closing date in the text, or published in the last 45 days. Time Out London (no current competitions), Evening Standard (no competitions page) and Londonist (no tag page) list none.
Guest view only shows a handful per page; direct promoter links need free login (not used).
Public list of paid house/cash prize draws with ticket price and value.
Public forum listing (robots permit); links go to forum threads that contain the entry link.

Bauer Media's paid prize-draw site (also on Bauer radio). Its pages are JS-rendered; the list and details come from the same public JSON the site loads for every anonymous visitor (guest session, no login). Free postal entry route per competition.
Metro's own prize-draw site (DMG Media), linked from metro.co.uk/competitions: paid tickets (typically 10p-£1) with a free postal entry route.
NCG's competitions listing (robots allow; feeds not used). Only entries whose page states a future closing date are kept.
Small paid car/bike/cash operator; own public listing.
Regional golf magazine's competitions category (WordPress RSS; robots allow all). Golf rounds, breaks, equipment; free to enter.
Operator's own public draw pages (Shopify).
Oracle Publications (UK) Ltd (Co. no. 06612831), Southend's free community magazine; regular gig, tribute-show, theatre and attraction ticket giveaways (online form, UK 18+).

Primary Times Ltd (Co. no. 09512881): family what's-on magazine with national + regional (incl. Hampshire) competitions pages; lots of family festival, panto and attraction tickets. Online form; terms and closing date on each page.

sources.source: Radio: Bauer / Hello Rayo (Kiss, Absolute, Hits, Magic, Jazz FM, Clyde…)
sources.note: Bauer Media public competition pages for 19 national/regional stations; closing dates are only on JS-rendered detail pages, so usually blank.

sources.source: Radio: Bauer regional stations (Hits Radio & Greatest Hits Radio areas)
sources.note: Bauer's regional win pages (32 areas, e.g. Hits Radio Manchester, Greatest Hits Radio Kent/Glasgow); local prizes not on the national pages. Greatest Hits Radio South Coast is its own source (Hampshire).

Express FM (Portsmouth) Ltd (Co. no. 05265112), Portsmouth's community radio station; its public /win/ page (local gig, theatre, Guildhall, light-show and Pompey tickets). Entry by web form; most comps are limited to PO postcodes. robots.txt crawl-delay 8.

sources.source: Radio: Global (Heart, Capital, Smooth, Classic FM, Radio X…)
sources.note: Public /win pages of Global stations. LBC/Gold: no public prize-draw list reachable (LBC redirects to news; gold.radio unreachable).

sources.source: Radio: Greatest Hits Radio South Coast (formerly Wave 105)
sources.note: Bauer's Hampshire/Dorset station; its public win page (Bauer competition terms apply). Heart South / Capital South have no separate public win page (Global's national pages are already collected); BBC Radio Solent lists no competitions.

sources.source: Red Funnel competitions (Isle of Wight events)
sources.note: Red Funnel Ltd (Co. no. 10823670, Southampton): the Isle of Wight ferry runs free prize draws on standalone pages of its own site (IoW festival / event tickets + ferry travel, Southampton Boat Show…). Found via its public sitemap (robots allow); kept only while the page's form is open and it states a future closing date.

Reach regional titles whose competitions page is public (others - MEN, Liverpool Echo, WalesOnline, Belfast Live, Bristol Post, SussexLive, CornwallLive, Nottingham Post, Leicester Mercury... - have none). Last 45 days only; tagged by place.
Independent south-of-England lifestyle magazine; event / festival / comedy ticket giveaways with an on-page form. Publisher company not shown on the site, so these are not brand-verified.

sources.source: Scotland local (Daily Record, Herald, National, Glasgow Times, Scottish Field)
sources.note: Daily Record (Reach) giveaways from the last 45 days; Newsquest's Scottish titles (network-wide prizes, merged); Scottish Field magazine competitions. Scottish Sun: robots.txt disallows all; Scotsman / Edinburgh Evening News / Press and Journal: no public competitions page.
Uses its published RSS feeds + public competition pages (details cached; a capped number fetched per run).
Bauer golf magazine's giveaways listing (robots allow). Only entries whose page states a future closing date are kept.
Immediate Media food & travel magazine's own competitions page (free to enter; closing dates are on each page).
